inheritance: The 13-dimension taxonomy, row fields, Target-minus-Reference convention, N/A rules, and evidence classifications are inherited unchanged from v1.

permanent_reference_terms.behavior_reference: Who the Target is compared against; defines behavior direction together with Target.
permanent_reference_terms.null_reference: Representation-specific paired randomization q95 or unpaired A/A calibration q95; 1.0x is the statistical-background reference line.
permanent_reference_terms.representation_baseline: old64 historical capability baseline; never defines behavior direction.

report_layers.name: Behavior Drift / Style Report Card
report_layers.question: What behavior changed in Target relative to Behavior Reference?
report_layers.identity_boundary: B measures behavior drift and is not the planner/version being evaluated.

report_layers.name: Representation Qualification Matrix
report_layers.question: How are old64/A/B/C/ego13 qualified for each fixed treatment and deployment mode?

primary_matrix_column.english: Highest standardized sensitivity on this treatment
primary_matrix_column.chinese: 该Treatment下最高标准化检测敏感度
primary_matrix_column.interpretation: Within-representation-null standardized sensitivity on this specific known treatment only; not completeness, generality, or global representation optimality.

shared_parent_bdd.footnote: † These semantic dimensions share the same parent task-level BDD and are not independent BDD tests.
shared_parent_bdd.counting_rule: The three semantic rows count as one independent BDD test per representation.

ego13_interpretation_boundary: ego13 has the highest within-null standardized sensitivity on several controlled treatments that directly act on ego kinematics. This does not make ego13 a general style representation and does not show neighbor/context is useless. Learned64 retains strong positive evidence for production-style unpaired release monitoring; representation capability is task- and deployment-conditioned.
